headline: Temporal reuse and selective VLM triggering ALREADY EXIST in production (P12 TriggerPolicy). The 2.0 calls/person figure reported in Phases 4.2-5D is an artifact of the evaluation harness, which deliberately bypasses tracking, the registry and demand freshness.

attribute_dependency_table.note: No validated deterministic classifier exists. Per Part C, none may be invented.
93% NOT_VISIBLE on wide cameras; the gate and region decide observability, not the covering state.

value_provenance.head_observability: pose module - EVALUATED in Phase 4.4, NOT wired into runtime

existing_vlm_suppression_mechanisms.assessment: Parts B, D and E of the Phase 6 brief describe a mechanism that is already implemented. fresh_enough is the temporal reuse; appearance_changed and quality_improved are the staleness invalidation; budget_exhausted is the cost ceiling.

critical_measurement_gap.problem: tools/vision_eval/predict.py runs frame-by-frame with no registry, no tracking and no demand freshness. It calls the VLM once per evidence group per subject per frame BY CONSTRUCTION.
critical_measurement_gap.consequence: Every VLM-usage number in Phases 4.2, 5C and 5D describes the harness, not production. Production usage is UNMEASURED and is bounded above by those figures, probably far below them.
critical_measurement_gap.implication: Phase 6 cannot compute a reduction percentage against a baseline that was never production behaviour. The baseline must be re-measured through the session pipeline first.
